messages.snippet: Sarah, Quick one on Project Atlas (the Brampton Leisure acquisition) - Harland Vesey have come back
messages.subject: Project Atlas - completion accounts query from Harland Vesey
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on Project Atlas (the Brampton Leisure acquisition) - Harland Vesey have come back on the completion accounts and are querying the working capital adjustment again. I think it's a rehash of the point we closed off in January but they want a call. Can I borrow you for 15 minutes tomorrow? Nothing urgent and entirely separate from the Vault litigation Tom's running.

James

James Osei | Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
